truth_boundary: These are candidate partners to qualify, not claims that they will bid, partner, or buy. Outreach requires human approval.

candidates.name: msg Public Sector
candidates.why_candidate: Public-sector AI and agentic process automation are explicit parts of its current German administration offering; it also offers AI systems around social-law knowledge and document workflows.
candidates.our_wedge: Offer CARE/Public Service and CasePilot as an evidence-rich social-benefits or agent-reliability module rather than competing on full-stack delivery.
qualification_questions: Would a specialist evaluated module improve their offer?
Can our proof be integrated under their architecture and compliance model?

candidates.name: Capgemini Public Sector Germany
candidates.why_candidate: Capgemini publicly works on modular and agent-based AI for German administration, including the SPARK initiative and public-sector AI-agent architecture.
candidates.our_wedge: Position our human-approval, replayability, source-evidence and benefit-domain proofs as a small specialist work package that can accelerate a larger delivery.
qualification_questions: Is there an existing bid or account team?
Which proof gap is expensive for them to build internally?
Can we enter as subcontractor, technology component or rapid proof partner?

candidates.name: adesso Public Sector
candidates.why_candidate: adesso's 2026 public-sector portfolio explicitly includes Agentic AI, public-administration AI and projects across federal, state and municipal government.
candidates.our_wedge: Sell a narrow evaluated specialist module: benefits workflow evidence, reliability evaluation, provenance or human-approval orchestration.
qualification_questions: Are they already serving the buyer or adjacent authorities?
Would our ready-made evaluation/proof layer shorten proposal delivery?

candidates.name: Materna Public Sector
candidates.why_candidate: Materna works with German federal authorities including BSI and is part of the SPARK administration-AI ecosystem, integrating AI-supported workflows into government IT landscapes.
candidates.our_wedge: Offer reliability/evidence and social-benefit workflow proof as a specialist component under an established public-sector integrator.
qualification_questions: Is there a relevant BSI/Dataport account team?
Which evidence, AI-assurance or domain component is missing?
Can we contribute through a subcontract or consortium role?

candidates.name: T-Systems Public Sector
candidates.why_candidate: T-Systems is actively positioning sovereign AI/cloud infrastructure and AI use in German municipal and public-sector environments.
candidates.our_wedge: Complement infrastructure with an inspectable application/evaluation layer rather than compete on hosting or enterprise platform scope.
qualification_questions: Is a specialist application layer useful to a larger platform offer?
Can we prove differentiation in under one week?
